name: Scarlet Woman
ability: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count.)
designRole: Conditional backup Demon when the current Demon dies with enough players alive.
explanation: Conditional backup Demon when the current Demon dies with enough players alive.

nightInstructions.otherNights: If the Scarlet Woman became the Demon today, show them the *YOU ARE* token, then the Demon token.

jinxes.reason: If Lil' Monsta dies with 5 or more players alive, the Scarlet Woman babysits Lil' Monsta for the rest of the game.
If the Storyteller would gain the Scarlet Woman ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
If there would be two Demons, one of which was the Scarlet Woman, the Scarlet Woman becomes the Scarlet Woman again.
If there would be two Demons, one of which was the Scarlet Woman, the Scarlet Woman remains the Scarlet Woman.
